benchmark.label: AeroDock 20-case landing benchmark
benchmark.description: Twenty matched MuJoCo/PX4 missions: landing, wind, waves, target acquisition and combined stress.
benchmark.aggregation: Weighted category mean; equal case weights within each category. Speed macro-averages the five mission-condition categories.
benchmark.design_note: Targeted teacher rerun on the four cases the frozen teacher failed. Only the combined bounded case changes geometry: orbit radius 14 m, decoy ring 22 m, inspection standoff 20.5 m. The wave case is unchanged and the wave-aware gate is a separate teacher policy. The other sixteen bounded-search cases and all historical results are unchanged.

models.label: Privileged teacher / wave-aware gate
models.note: Canonical-plan full-20 evidence from the 9 November wave-gate run.

models.label: Fresh search student / frozen R15
models.note: Existing 8 November 20-case test plus a canonical combined-rock rerun on 11 November: 18/20 strict landings, 20/20 valid. The 6/6 and 12/14 handoff runs are unioned; the canonical rerun completes the combined category.

notes: Teacher evidence is the existing verified full-20 run; it is not rerun.
Student evidence is the existing 8 November 20-case test plus the canonical combined-rock rerun on 11 November: 18/20 strict landings, 20/20 valid.
All four models now have canonical-plan coverage; carried-forward evidence is marked per episode.
benchmark/policies is read-only and untouched by the tracker.
Carried-forward results are marked in each result source and are never silently relabelled.
